text.content:
Estates, real lawns, and guards who shoot first.

Region: Westbrook (district I). Was: the Executive Zone, the east of Charter Hill
Controlled by: Lazarus at the gates; private teams inside them
The feel of it: About four thousand people on more land than Kabuki. Nothing happens by accident
Notable locations: Arasaka Estate (#18), Columbarium (#19), Villa Eurodyne (#20), Chram Denya Jinja (#21), North Oak Casino & CC (#22)
Danger: Executive. SC 10 (Lazarus and estate security, Hardened Heavy). UC 1

The 2045 Executive Zone grew a name and more land. Board members, celebrities, heirs and the occasional old rockerboy who invested well live here. The Columbarium and the shrine are the only places open to the public.

Getting Past the Gate

The gate asks for an invitation, a resident's call or a service pass. Some people talk their way in, and a few bribe their way in once. A drawn weapon brings estate security within seconds and Lazarus within a minute.

Places

  • Arasaka Estate (#18). SC 10. A Japanese garden estate behind three walls. Michiko Arasaka lives here when she isn't at the Clock Tower.
  • Columbarium (#19). SC 8. A cemetery tower for the city's rich dead, open to visitors by day.
  • Villa Eurodyne (#20). SC 9. A private club for European executives: real wine, real cigars, real arms deals.
  • Chram Denya Jinja (#21). SC 8. A Shinto shrine on the hill, open at dawn. Arasaka paid to restore it in 2070.
  • North Oak Casino & CC (#22). SC 9. The only casino in the hills, with a members-only golf course and big games in the back.

Getting There

NCART: North Oak Gate, Columbarium (Star Line).

Turf

None. Not one.

People

  • Gloria Vane (Rockerboy 6, retired). Throws parties for people who want to meet the old stars.
  • Captain Duke Okonkwo (Solo 7, Lazarus). Runs the gate patrols.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.09
